description: Explicit, auditable dispositions for historical release verdicts. An entry does NOT convert a FAIL/NOT_VERIFIED verdict into PASS. It only documents why a specific historical failure does not represent an implementation failure, so the default blocking behavior is not silently bypassed. Default remains blocking for any verdict without a disposition.

entries.rationale: The historical SCHOL-109 G5 FAIL was caused solely by the PHP executable being unavailable in the verification environment: all three 'php -l' checks failed with '/bin/sh: 1: php: not found'. The only non-PHP dependent check in the same verdict (Production HTTP 200) MET, and the ticket's structural gate G0 PASSED. The underlying implementation is present (the ListOutput($functions→group) fix is recorded in SCHOL-109). This disposition does NOT convert the FAIL to PASS; it only documents that the historical failure did not represent an implementation defect.
entries.scope: Limited strictly to SCHOL-109 gate G5 historical verdict. Applies to release-eligibility verification only and does not retroactively change the historical verdict file.
entries.effective_behavior: For release-eligibility verification, SCHOL-109's historical G5 FAIL is recorded as DISPOSITIONED (visible in verification output) rather than as an unresolvable blocker. It is not presented as a current successful verification.
entries.authorized_by: REMEDIATION PHASE 2 — Changeset A (release verdict gating)
